name: Parents' House
description: The falu-red house you grew up in. Your childhood room still has the ice hockey posters.
greeting: The cat ignores you, as usual.
The coffee pot is always on.
Dad is fixing the moped in the yard. Again.

hello: Oh, it's you! Take your shoes off.
Your father wants to talk about your future. Run.
Did you remember your hat? It's cold out.
relax: Have a nap, I'll bring coffee.
eat_soup: Have you thought about a real career?
There's more in the pot. And more advice.
move_back: Your room is just as you left it!
Welcome home. House rules still apply.
refuse: You know that's not how it works.

actions.label: Relax in your old room
actions.description: Rest and recharge. Mom will bring coffee.

effects.message: You nap, read old Aku Ankka comics and feel a bit better.

actions.label: Eat Mom's soup
actions.description: Free food, served with a side of life advice. Mom feeds visitors too, once a week, and they have to stay for coffee.

requires.message: Mom already fed you this week. "Do you even buy groceries?"

then.message: Salmon soup and rye bread. And a lecture.

else.message: Salmon soup, rye bread, three cups of coffee and the whole family news. It takes a while.

effects.message: You carry your boxes back up the stairs.
